parsed.name: TCP值客户端
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，通过 TCP 在局域网中连接值服务端并读取远程发送的数据。它适用于实验系统之间传递传感器读数、控制量或状态值，而不是直接控制某一台具体实验仪器。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that connects to a value server over TCP on a local network and reads remotely transmitted data. It is used to pass sensor readings, control values, or status values between experiment systems rather than directly controlling a specific laboratory instrument.
